ai_positioning.summary: The company identifies risks related to artificial intelligence implementation including potential legal and operational liabilities from mismanaged AI applications, indicating awareness of emerging AI risks but no significant current AI integration in core operations.
evidence: Risk factor identified: 'Risks likaed to artificial intelligence' with severity 3, noting potential responsibilities from poor AI management
ai_positioning._validation: Corrected stance from 'absent' to 'emerging' based on explicit AI risk factor in Item 1A; AI is recognized as emerging risk not operational advantage

risks.title: Intense competition and margin pressure
risks.score_rationale: Principal risk identified in risk factor summary describing highly competitive business environment with pressure on sales and results of operations. Direct impact on core financial performance metrics. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: The company faces intense global competition with large multinational competitors and agile new entrants that exert pressure on pricing and margins.

risks.title: Strategic transformation execution and M&A risks
risks.score_rationale: Material adverse effect risk explicitly stated regarding inability to execute strategic transformation or manage collaborations, joint ventures, acquisitions and divestitures. Recent $1.153B goodwill impairment demonstrates realized impact. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Failure to successfully execute strategic transformation initiatives or integrate acquisitions could materially harm financial condition and operating results.

risks.title: Antitrust investigations and class action litigation
risks.score_rationale: Ongoing antitrust investigations and related class action lawsuits explicitly mentioned as material uncertainties in risk factor summary. Potential for significant legal and financial consequences. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Ongoing antitrust investigations and class action lawsuits could result in substantial fines, penalties and restrictions on business operations.

risks.title: Data breach or major IT system disruption
risks.score_rationale: Significant data breach or IT disruption identified as risk that could disrupt operations and result in loss of confidential information. Material operational and reputational impact. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: A major information technology breach or system disruption could interrupt operations and result in loss of confidential data and reputational harm.

risks.title: Volatility of raw material and input costs
risks.score_rationale: Increases in input costs including raw materials, transportation and energy have been exacerbated by recent inflationary pressures. Direct impact on gross margins which declined from gross profit impact of $264M from divestitures. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Increases in raw material costs, energy and transportation expenses, amplified by recent inflation, pressure margins and competitiveness.

risks.title: Foreign exchange rate fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: Geographic diversity with sales across multiple countries and currencies creates structural exposure. Exchange rate impact on 2025 sales was less than 1% but represents ongoing headwind. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Fluctuations in foreign exchange rates can reduce reported revenues and impact financial performance across international operations.

risks.title: Artificial intelligence application risks
risks.score_rationale: Emerging risk explicitly identified regarding potential legal and operational liabilities from mismanaged AI applications. Represents new area of concern as adoption increases. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Mismanagement of artificial intelligence applications could expose the company to legal liabilities and operational risks.

risks.title: Environmental compliance and sustainability costs
risks.score_rationale: Increasing regulatory pressure and investor expectations on sustainability and environmental performance. Risk of facility closures or sanctions for non-compliance with strengthening environmental regulations. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Non-compliance with environmental standards or failure to meet sustainability expectations could result in substantial costs, sanctions and facility restrictions.

company_description: International Flavors & Fragrances Inc., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and markets food, beverage, health and biosciences, scent, and complementary adjacent products in the United States, and internationally. It operates in through Taste, Food Ingredients, Health & Biosciences, and Scent segments. The Taste segment offers savory products such as soups, sauces, meat, fish, poultry, snacks; beverages consists of juice drinks, carbonated or flavored beverages, spirits; sweets comprising, bakery products, candy, cereal, chewing gum; and dairy products, such as yogurt, ice cream, cheese, and other products, as well as spices and seasoning ingredients for meat, food service, convenience, alternative protein and culinary products. The Food Ingredients segment provides natural, artificial, and plant-based specialty food ingredients; natural antioxidants and anti-microbials used for natural food preservation and shelf-life extension for beverages, cosmetic and healthcare products, pet food and feed additives; and savory solutions, such as spices, marinades, and mixtures, and inclusion products comprising  combining flavorings with fruit, vegetables and other natural ingredien
